meta.rationale: A little handheld console you hold in both hands: its screen is your world, and every app is a cartridge you slot in.
meta.theme-about: cute handheld game console: a full-screen canvas of a chunky two-tone console (cherry red body, navy grip, a d-pad, round A and B buttons, a speaker grille, a power light that blinks), its big screen showing a soft pixel landscape with drifting clouds; the companion glows in the corner of the screen; the apps are game cartridges with labels stacked in a slot rack beside it; rounded plastic shapes, scarlet, navy and cream. Playful, pocket-sized. (#console, #screen, #carts)

desktop.canvas: function draw(w, h, t) g.gradient(0, 0, w, h, "#f6e6df", "#ead9f0") -- the console body local bx, by, bw, bh = w * 0.06, h * 0.08, w * 0.66, h * 0.84 g.rect(bx + 10, by + 16, bw, bh, "#a8213a55", 60) g.rect(bx, by, bw, bh, "#e23d55", 60) g.rect(bx + 14, by + 14, bw - 28, bh * 0.5, "#ec5a6f", 48) -- the screen: a soft pixel world local sx, sy, sw, sh = bx + bw * 0.18, by + 46, bw * 0.64, bh * 0.56 g.rect(sx - 14, sy - 14, sw + 28, sh + 28, "#2a2f55", 22) g.gradient(sx, sy, sw, sh, "#7ec8ff", "#ffd6dc") for i = 0, 4 do local cx = (i * 190 + t * 18) % (sw + 160) - 80 if cx > 10 and cx < sw - 90 then g.rect(sx + cx, sy + 40 + i * 24, 70, 18, "#ffffffcc", 9) g.rect(sx + cx + 18, sy + 30 + i * 24, 34, 18, "#ffffffcc", 9) end end for x = 0, sw - 16, 16 do local hh = 40 + math.floor(18 * math.sin(x * 0.02 + 1)) g.rect(sx + x, sy + sh - hh, 16, hh, "#7fd38a") g.rect(sx + x, sy + sh - hh, 16, 6, "#5bbf6c") end g.rect(sx, sy + sh - 22, sw, 22, "#c98a5a") -- the hearts of a little life bar for i = 0, 2 do local hx, hy = sx + sw - 110 + i * 32, sy + 22 g.circle(hx - 5, hy, 7, "#e23d55"); g.circle(hx + 5, hy, 7, "#e23d55") g.poly({hx - 12, hy + 2, hx + 12, hy + 2, hx, hy + 15}, "#e23d55") end -- the d-pad, the buttons, the grille local dy = by + bh * 0.8 local dx = bx + bw * 0.2 g.rect(dx - 60, dy - 20, 120, 40, "#2a2f55", 10); g.rect(dx - 20, dy - 60, 40, 120, "#2a2f55", 10) g.circle(dx, dy, 10, "#3a4074") local ax = bx + bw * 0.78 local press = math.floor(t * 1.5) % 4 == 0 g.circle(ax + 46, dy - 26, 30, press and "#c42a40" or "#2a2f55") g.circle(ax - 26, dy + 18, 30, "#2a2f55") g.text(ax + 36, dy - 40, "A", "#fffaf6", 22, "Unbounded") g.text(ax - 36, dy + 4, "B", "#fffaf6", 22, "Unbounded") for i = 0, 5 do g.rect(bx + bw * 0.44 + i * 22, dy + 20, 10, 50, "#c42a40", 5) end g.rect(bx + bw * 0.42, dy - 40, 50, 16, "#2a2f55", 8); g.rect(bx + bw * 0.52, dy - 40, 50, 16, "#2a2f55", 8) local blink = (math.sin(t * 2) + 1) / 2 g.circle(bx + 46, by + 46, 7, string.format("#7dffb0%02x", math.floor(120 + 135 * blink))) g.glow(bx + 46, by + 46, 18, string.format("#7dffb0%02x", math.floor(60 * blink))) end
